notes: Product: JetBrains plugins (IntelliJ/PyCharm) for code completion + local repo indexing.
Goal: fast in-IDE completions with local index and optional private inference for LL models; keep keystrokes latency <50ms for single-token streaming where possible.
Current infra: distributed SaaS + optional on-prem agent for index ingestion. Primarily Java/Python monorepos, 50-200 devs.
Preference: model/version pinning; want ability to pin a quantized LLM for deterministic completions across releases.
Security: require SSO (Okta), audit logs for completion queries, ability to keep repository embeddings on-prem or within VPC (no external upload).
Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to buy dedicated capacity for predictable latency but want Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token spend.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-14): 'We need a plugin that behaves offline and never leaks repo content — if Redwood can run inference inside our VPC with local index, it's a go.'
Pilot ask: 20 developer seats, 2-week POC evaluating latency, model quality, and index sync workflow. POC dataset: 8 public and 3 private repos (~30GB).

Technical ask: local indexer agent (small JVM process) that pushes embeddings to Private cluster inside customer VPC OR keeps embedding store on-prem with query proxying; wants SDK for plugin to request streaming tokens and support cursor-level telemetry.
Integration notes: VertexForge builds plugin using IntelliJ Platform SDK; will need plugin dev build from Redwood with streaming and offline mode flags toggles.
Security review: uploaded security checklist (drive link). Legal wants indemnity wording for on-prem agent; legal loop slow — blocker for procurement.
Existing vendors: evaluating Tabnine Enterprise and internal microservice; Redwood's differentiation: model pinning + batching knobs + observability per-route.
Key metrics they care about: median first-byte latency for completion, tokens/sec per GPU, false positive rate on suggestions, percentage of completions needing context truncation.
Internal stakeholders: CTO (Elena Park), Head of Developer Tools (Ravi Singh), Engineering Manager (Sara Holt).
AE notes: demo 2026-02-28 went well; devs liked streaming demo inside PyCharm; SE to send POC checklist and infra diagram.
